notes.title: Now with Achievements!
notes.notes:
So, now the game has achievements.

However, the overlay of the achievement unlocked might stick on the screen until you alt + tab.

I'm already looking for a fix for this.

Let me know if you are facing this problem as well. Soon as everything is fine, I'll add more achievements (for example: Get X score on Dark Mode, kill X monsters, and so on).
